an3.52:1.1: Atha kho dve brāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuḍḍhā mahallakā addhagatā vayo-anuppattā vīsaṃvassasatikā jātiyā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu . . . pe . . . Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te brāhmaṇā Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
an3.52:1.2: Mayaṃ assu bho Gotama brāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuḍḍhā mahallakā addhagatā vayo-anuppattā vīsaṃvassasatikā jātiyā
an3.52:1.3: te c' amhā akatakalyāṇā akatakusalā akatabhīruttāṇā,
an3.52:1.4: ovadatu no bhavaṃ Gotamo anusāsatu no bhavaṃ Gotamo yaṃ amhākaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā ti.
an3.52:2.1: Taggha tumhe brāhmaṇā jiṇṇā vuddhā mahallakā addhagatā vayo-anuppattā vīsaṃvassasatikā jātiyā
an3.52:2.2: te c' attha akatakalyāṇā akatakusalā akatabhīruttāṇā.
an3.52:2.3: Āditto kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇā loko jarāya vyādhinā maraṇena,
an3.52:2.4: evaṃ āditte brāhmaṇā loke jarāya vyādhinā maraṇena yo 'dha kāyena saṃyamo vācāya saṃyamo manasā saṃyamo taṃ tassa petassa tāṇañ ca lenañ ca dīpañ ca saraṇañ ca parāyanañ cā ti.
